summary: Magic Empire Global Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing an At-the-Market Offering Agreement, or US-equivalent equity distribution agreement, with Chaince Securities, LLC as exclusive sales agent. The company may sell up to US$100,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares under its effective Form F-3 shelf, filed September 8, 2026, declared effective September 17, 2026, via prospectus supplement dated September 30, 2026. Agent compensation is 3.5% agency fee plus 1.0% non-accountable expense allowance. No shares are committed and no board recommendation or advisor fairness opinion is cited. Watch pricing, dilution and any trading overhang.
